name: AI-invoice-processor
description: AI invoice processor: extracts invoice fields from PDFs and scans using OCR and an LLM (Gemini/Claude), validates them with deterministic rules, and requires human review before CSV export. Live Streamlit demo.

paragraphs: A Streamlit app that reads an invoice (PDF, PNG or JPEG), extracts seven header fields with an LLM, checks them with deterministic rules, and makes a person review, correct and approve every record before it can be exported to CSV.
▶ Try the live demo: pick a sample invoice, process it, fix a wrong total, approve, export.
features: OCR fallback per page: digital PDFs use embedded text, and scanned pages go through Tesseract with auto-rotation.
LLM extraction behind a swappable adapter (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, or an offline baseline), with a strict JSON schema, quoted evidence, and a versioned prompt.
Nothing is invented or auto-approved. Missing values stay null, the model's quotes are checked against the document, and the arithmetic, duplicate and date rules block approval.
An append-only review history keeps the original AI output next to every human correction.
It's measured: an evaluation harness with a held-out split, per-field accuracy and sample sizes, plus 104 tests in CI.

whatItDoes.text: A Streamlit app that reads an invoice (PDF, PNG or JPEG), extracts seven header fields with an LLM, checks them with deterministic rules, and makes a person review, correct and approve every record before it can be exported to CSV.

requirements.text: Optionally set LLMINPUTCOSTPERMTOK / LLMOUTPUTCOSTPERMTOK (USD per million tokens) so cost is reported; if they're blank, cost shows as "not available" rather than a guess.
Tests don't need network access or an API key.
